limitations: All 23 runtime checks have their expected outcomes; negative cases are not successful downloads.
29 timing trials: 23 files verify; curl/aria2c each fail all three D trials, retained with their actual payloads.
B uses segmented automatic 32 versus diagnostic 1/2/5 total requested connections; D uses 16 maximum for both IDG variants.

D faults are independently generated, not paired by the file seed.
Helper count is still fixed; no production pause/cancel or unknown-length support.
